status: Proposed specification; not an implemented or validated MATLAB configuration

randomness.repetition_index: Zero based; 0..99 for pilot, 0..499 for production
randomness.scenario_pairing: Scenario excluded from substream ID: reuse base draws across conditions and robustness variants; never share estimation and validation substreams
randomness.reserved_domain: Only the declared stage, role, repetition and source values; extending their ranges requires a versioned mapping to avoid collisions

generation.input_scale_policy: Designed ensemble variance; no short-record variance renormalization
generation.noise_scale_policy: Expected full-band output variance; phase variants preserve reference absolute noise variance

main_design.scenario_id_rule: Canonical named values, for example c=0.50|q=0.25|snr=10|template=reference-v1; never row number

evaluation.primary_error: Per frequency: abs(Hestimate-Htruth)^2 / mean_band(abs(Htruth)^2); denominator uses truth only
evaluation.phase_mask: abs(Htruth) >= max(0.05*RMS_band(abs(Htruth)),sqrt(eps)); identical mask for estimators; no phase at zero truth
evaluation.truth: Exact saved digital filter response; no truth re-estimation
evaluation.zero_co2_pathway: Absolute complex error; normalized error and phase undefined
evaluation.primary_advantage: log10(mean_repetitions(SISO_frequency_error)/mean_repetitions(MISO_frequency_error)); paired finite cases, with separate failure accounting
evaluation.score_schema: v2-ratio-of-mean-errors; incompatible with legacy mean-log-ratio advantage
evaluation.zero_error_ratio: Both zero: exact tie; one zero: signed infinity with display saturation flag; no added error floor
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 bootstrap draws of whole paired repetition IDs; share resampled IDs across frequencies and scenarios; pointwise 95% intervals

analysis_randomness.purpose: bootstrap repetition-index matrix only; save resolved matrix

primary_axes.y: assigned factor level; explicitly condition/facet remaining factors
primary_axes.color: log10(mean_repetitions(SISO_frequency_error)/mean_repetitions(MISO_frequency_error)); paired finite cases, with separate failure accounting

figures.diagnostic_weighting: Equal-weight 27-scenario reference ensemble; facet by SNR; report contributing scenarios and finite-case counts

real_data_extension.status: Later implementation chunk; not needed for simulation
real_data_extension.rng_contract: Separate versioned namespace keyed by participant, recording, null type and surrogate ID; freeze before real-data implementation
real_data_extension.scope: Unrelated-input references, not a conditional null preserving MAP-CO2 coupling
